title: Level cap 30, three new dungeons, and the first full class-tuning pass
summary: The October 1 build raises the level cap to 30, opens Excavation Site: Wetlands plus Razorfen Downs and Uldaman, and ships the first tuning pass touching every class. Blizzard's notes also describe a full Fury/Protection Warrior rework that is not yet present in the beta client data this site reads from -- see the Warrior section below and the data-sync note at the bottom of the page.
pendingInData: Warrior: Blizzard's notes describe a full Fury and Protection rework (new talents Lingering Rage, Furious Precision, and Gore Drinker; Improved Cleave and Boundless Rage removed; Raging Blows no longer needing a talent point for Whirlwind's off-hand strike; a Protection row reshuffle moving Iron Will, Anticipation, Improved Bloodrage, Improved Revenge, Improved Disarm, and Improved Shield Bash; Toughness removed). None of this is present yet in the beta client data this site reads from, so the talent planner still shows the previous Fury/Protection trees. The entries below are listed for completeness but won't resolve to matching tooltips until a build with this data ships.

Warrior: Spearing Strike no longer requiring a two-handed weapon (and instead requiring Battle Stance) is also not yet reflected in the data -- the planner still lists its old two-handed weapon requirement.
Hunter and Warlock: Aggressive Mode's return to the pet tab is not yet present in the beta client data this site reads from.

Shaman: the Ghost Wolf visibility fix, the Disease Cleansing Totem duration fix, and the Totemic Recall mana fix are client-side/mechanical fixes with no tooltip-text signal in the beta client data, so there is nothing for the planner's spellbook pages to update.

druid.name: Bear Form
druid.text: Bear Form and Dire Bear Form now generate 75% increased Rage when landing a critical strike.

druid.name: Dire Bear Form
druid.text: See Bear Form above -- the same 75% increased Rage on critical strikes applies here too.

druid.name: Swipe
druid.text: Fixed a bug causing Swipe to not scale with Attack Power. It now correctly gains 3% of the Druid's Attack Power.
druid.devNote: The tooltip will not update correctly until a future update.

druid.name: Faerie Fire
druid.text: No longer resets your swing timer when used.

druid.name: Primal Bite
druid.text: Threat generated by this ability has been roughly doubled.

druid.name: King of the Jungle
druid.text: Removed from the Feral Combat tree.

druid.name: Shifting Power
druid.text: New talent connected to Shredding Attacks in the 4th row. Cat Form only, 16 sec cooldown, costs 55% of base Mana (the same amount Cat Form itself costs). Instantly converts 55% of base Mana into 40 Energy; its cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

druid.name: Improved Shifting Power
druid.text: New talent connected to Shifting Power in the 5th row. Reduces the cooldown of Shifting Power by 4/8 sec.

hunter.name: Improved Stings
hunter.text: Icon changed to feel more Vanilla.

hunter.name: Sniper Shot
hunter.text: The 31-point talent now has 45 yard range, and increases the range of your next 3 shots made within 10 sec by 10 yards.

hunter.name: Predator's Edge
hunter.text: Icon changed to feel more Vanilla.

hunter.name: Deflection
hunter.text: Parry chance per rank changed to 1/2/3/4/5% (was 2/4/6/8/10%).

hunter.name: Aggressive Mode
hunter.text: Brought back and available again under the pet tab in your spellbook.
hunter.devNote: There were some tameable beasts with ranks of pet abilities that were too high level for that creature. They have all been fixed. This could result in a bug where your pet "forgot" the pet ability, which should not happen after this fix.

mage.name: Fireball
mage.text: All Mage scrolls from comprehension have had an additional balance pass and can no longer be cast while moving.

mage.name: Hot Streak
mage.text: Renamed to Heating Up, since it's no longer dependent on having a "streak."

mage.name: Improved Scorch
mage.text: Fire Vulnerability no longer rolls a second time to check for a resist.

mage.name: Winter's Chill
mage.text: Its application no longer rolls to see if it's resisted, since the original spell already needed to hit.

paladin.name: Redoubt
paladin.text: Chance to Block per rank changed to 4/8/12/16/20% (was 6/12/18/24/30%).

paladin.name: Champion of the Light
paladin.devNote: Champion of the Light had a tooltip issue saying it increased Healing; it did not. This tooltip has been removed.

priest.name: Shadow Word: Death
priest.text: Fixed an issue where it was always benefitting from the Early Demise talent regardless of the target's health %.

priest.name: Inner Focus
priest.text: No longer applies its critical strike increase to periodic effects.

priest.name: Shadow Weaving
priest.text: Can no longer fail to apply.

rogue.name: Expose Armor
rogue.text: Fixed an issue where missing with it would cause you to lose all of your combo points.

rogue.name: Setup
rogue.text: Now only adds a Combo Point to your current target if they're the one you Dodged an attack from or resisted a spell from.

shaman.name: Ghost Wolf
shaman.text: Should now be more visible while in well-lit areas.

shaman.name: Disease Cleansing Totem
shaman.text: Fixed an issue where it wasn't actually a 5 minute duration.

shaman.name: Totemic Recall
shaman.text: Fixed an issue where it was not restoring Mana.

warlock.name: Drain Soul
warlock.text: Now correctly interrupted if the Warlock begins casting another spell.

warlock.name: Summon Incubus
warlock.label: Incubus
warlock.text: The Incubus pet model has been replaced with a lower resolution model.

warlock.name: Soul Harvesting
warlock.text: Renamed to Soul Harvest. It now correctly grants its 50/100% increase to Mana regeneration.

warlock.name: Aggressive Mode
warlock.text: Back, and available again under the pet tab in your spellbook.

warrior.name: Bloodrage
warrior.label: Critical strikes (basic attacks)
warrior.text: Players now generate 75% increased Rage when landing a critical strike with a basic attack.

warrior.name: Rend
warrior.text: Rend and Sunder Armor will now instantly tap enemies to the Warrior.

warrior.name: Heroic Strike
warrior.text: Queueing it will no longer increase off-hand hit chance.

warrior.name: Dual Wield Specialization
warrior.text: Fixed a bug causing it to grant its increase to Hit Chance to both weapons instead of just the off-hand.
warrior.devNote: Because of the above bug, our tests needed some correcting, so we did another pass on Fury Warrior.

warrior.name: Spearing Strike
warrior.text: No longer requires a two-handed weapon. Now requires Battle Stance.

warrior.name: Dual Wield Specialization
warrior.text: No longer provides a 20/40/60/80/100% increase to your off-hand weapon's Rage generation, and no longer grants Hit Chance to your off-hand attacks.

warrior.name: Unbridled Rage
warrior.text: Fixed an issue with it having a lower than intended proc chance.
warrior.devNote: Our goal here is to give Fury more access to utility and meaningful choices early in the tree for leveling, and free up points later for more choices instead of being stuck placing points into Enrage to get Flurry.

warrior.name: Booming Voice
warrior.text: Now a 10/20/30/40/50% increase to the area of effect of your Shouts and a 5/10/15/20/25% reduction to their Rage costs.

warrior.name: Unbridled Wrath
warrior.text: No longer grants twice as much Rage to two-handed weapons.

warrior.name: Lingering Rage
warrior.text: New talent in Row 2. Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay when leaving combat by 2/4/6/8/10 sec.

warrior.name: Blood Craze
warrior.text: No longer activates off of Bloodthirst casts.

warrior.name: Improved Cleave
warrior.text: Removed.

warrior.name: Boundless Rage
warrior.text: Removed.

warrior.name: Furious Precision
warrior.text: New talent in Row 3. Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 4/7/10%.

warrior.name: Raging Blows
warrior.text: Now reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3 (previously Cleave only, by 2). No longer causes Whirlwind to strike with your off-hand -- Whirlwind now always strikes with both weapons without requiring a talent point.

warrior.name: Flurry
warrior.text: Enrage is no longer required to reach Flurry; Death Wish is now required instead.

warrior.name: Gore Drinker
warrior.text: New talent in Row 6, requires Enrage. Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 0.5/1% of your maximum Health.

warrior.name: Improved Berserker Rage
warrior.text: Moved to Row 5 (was Row 6).

warrior.name: Berserker Rage
warrior.text: Now available at level 30 (was 32).

warrior.name: Bloodthirst
warrior.text: Attack Power ratio increased to 45% (was 35%).

warrior.name: Iron Will
warrior.text: Moved to Row 1 of Protection (was Row 2 of Fury).
warrior.devNote: Our goal is to give non-shield users a clear path to the middle of the tree, where Protection could serve as a PvP tech secondary specialization, with more access to Improved Bloodrage, Iron Will, Improved Disarm, Last Stand, and Improved Shield Bash.

warrior.name: Anticipation
warrior.text: Moved to Row 2 (was Row 1).

warrior.name: Toughness
warrior.text: Removed.

warrior.name: Improved Bloodrage
warrior.text: Moved to Row 1 (was Row 2).

warrior.name: Improved Revenge
warrior.text: Moved to Row 2 (was Row 3).

warrior.name: Improved Disarm
warrior.text: Moved to Row 3 (was Row 4).

warrior.name: Improved Shield Bash
warrior.text: Moved to Row 4 (was Row 5).

races.name: Eureka!
races.text: No longer benefits periodic effects at all. Channeled spells do not count as periodics.

races.name: Cannibalize
races.text: Cannot be used if the caster is immune to Physical damage.

points.text: Improved rain visibility.
Removed the "Ray Traced Shadows" option. It will be re-added in a future update after the functionality is fixed.
Fixed an issue where the Night Watchman's Torch was causing unintended lag in certain situations and could not be cancelled.
The visual size of weapons when held in hand and sheathed on the back has been adjusted across all races to be more consistent.
Players can now level up to a maximum of level 30.
New Dungeon: Excavation Site: Wetlands (levels 26-31).

Players now have access to Razorfen Downs (25+) and Uldaman (30+), in addition to the already-available Ragefire Chasm, Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, Wailing Caverns, The Deadmines, Shadowfang Keep, The Stockade, Blackfathom Deeps, Gnomeregan, Razorfen Kraul, and Scarlet Monastery.
There are now barbershops in Darnassus and Thunder Bluff; all barbershops have barbers working at them, and city guards will give directions to the nearest one.

Camping: the Boosted Rest debuff from this feature now has a clearer icon and a rewritten tooltip; camping terminology now says "mutually exclusive" instead of just "exclusive"; and campfires no longer damage players below level 5, dealing reduced damage to players under 90% health.

Items: Savory Whimsyfin Delight now uses an orc equivalent of the Ninja/Pirate outfits from Savory Deviate Delight. Selling a BoE item with an uncollected appearance to a vendor now makes it soulbound (was Bound to Account). Developers' notes: "The prior transformations were placeholder, but we may reintroduce similar ones in the future!"
Racial abilities are now supported.
Rogue is now supported.
Duplicate entries for each spell rank on already-supported classes should no longer appear.
The pet stable interface has been updated for gamepad support.
Gamepad UI bindings are now static; any gamepad rebinding only affects the keyboard and mouse interface.
The compact Raid and Party manager frames have been updated for gamepad support.
Fixed an issue preventing macros placed on a gamepad action bar from being moved.
Honor costs for PvP gear and upgrade tokens have been adjusted, with most item costs increasing by approximately 50% to better align with gear acquisition targets.
The Honor cap has been increased from 15,000 to 25,000 to accommodate the above new costs.
Shenthul in Orgrimmar will now train Windshaper Skyborne.
A number of recipes intended for Blacksmithing and Leatherworking as random dungeon drops are now available.
Enchanting: all crafted common and uncommon quality wands now sell at vendors for 1 copper.
Mining: reduced the amount of Poor Copper Vein nodes available in starter areas.
Skinning: creatures can once again only be skinned a single time before disappearing.

Dungeon quests now reward 50% less extra experience beyond normal quest values. Developers' notes: "We appreciate the feedback on leveling speed as we continue ongoing discussions about the Beta. As part of those discussions, we've decided to reduce the amount of XP granted from dungeon quests with this release. Certain quest rewards have also been recalibrated."
Resolved an issue with players being unable to start escort quests if their quest log contained 25 or more quests.
Resolved an issue with certain quest items being multi-drop.
Resolved an issue with some quests that give items on start being shareable, and some quests that come from items being shareable.

Increased the respawn rate across many creatures and objects in Hillsbrad Foothills, Ashenvale, Wetlands, Duskwood, and Thousand Needles. Developers' notes: "Redridge Mountains and Stonetalon Mountains were adjusted in a previous build. Please continue to submit any areas where you have difficulty completing quests, and we will continue to make adjustments."
Darkshore: resolved an issue with the Tharnariun's Hope item during the quest "Plagued Lands".
Deadmines: "Destruction in Deadmines" now sorts correctly in the quest log for the dungeon.

Druid: fixed an issue where players weren't reliably receiving loot during "The Great Cat Spirit" and "The Great Windborne Cat Spirit." High Order Skyborne can now do "Power Over Poison" to learn Cure Poison.
Dun Morogh: Shimmer Ridge trolls will respawn more evenly and faster in areas where they were sluggish.
Loch Modan: troggs in the Loch now respawn slightly more slowly for "In Defense of the King's Lands."
Mulgore: the quest "Kyle's Gone Missing!" has been added.
Orgrimmar: Smooth Boulder should be far more plentiful and available to gather for "Rocks to Rests."
Redridge Mountains: the quest "Blackrock Blockade" has been updated, and its spawn rates adjusted.
Ruins of Lordaeron: "A Frightened Request" now sorts correctly in the quest log under the dungeon. Resolved an issue where players could receive multiple copies of the Bloodied Insignia quest item.
Wailing Caverns: Serpentbloom Snakes now despawn after a couple of minutes.

Westfall: significantly reduced the respawn rate of the pocket watch in Furlbrow's Wardrobe for "The Forgotten Heirloom." Increased respawn rate for the undead in "Collecting Memories" and for Foreman Thistlenettle in "Oh Brother..."

On the character sheet, mousing over Spell Damage and Spell Healing now explains that spells cast using spell ranks vastly below your current level receive less benefit from Spell Damage/Healing and have a reduced chance to activate class abilities and talents (e.g. Frostbite, Omen of Clarity). Developers' notes: "Another example of this reduction in activation chance -- using a Rank 1 Frostbolt at level 60 will result in a 0% chance to get a Frostbite activation. So you now are making a decision between getting a slow off quickly, or using a spell that can potentially get a Frostbite activation, instead of getting both."
Character Creation now displays matching icons when Standard Definition models are toggled.
Stables frame art has been updated.
Combo points on the target frame and Personal Resource Display have updated art.
Fixed loot rolls in chat not displaying a player's full name.
The auction house will now correctly display item suffixes.

Adjustments have been made to world instances. Party leaders should no longer be transferred when creating or updating a party's composition. Developers' notes: "As we continue to iterate on features that impact player populations and grouping, we look forward to your feedback and bug reports."

other.heading: Known Issues - New to this build

points.text: Chaining spells together does not play the precast spell effects/sounds of the next cast until the first cast finishes -- for example, casting Fireball twice in a row won't show the hand-glow/crackling sound for the second cast until the first cast's animation finishes.
Enemies can Parry and Block from behind if the player is close to them. Can be avoided by not standing too close to targets.
The total installation size of WoW: Forever is larger than intended; Blizzard is working to reduce it in a future Beta update.
Switching to or from Gamepad UI mode resets the active edit mode layout to the default preset.
Scroll of Liminal Passage does not function correctly.
Dwarf player-characters do not have updated splash sounds in water (fixed in a later build).
Eureka! does not affect every damaging or healing spell for some classes (fixed in a later build).
Multiple debuffs like Faerie Fire and Demoralizing Shout don't cause threat.
Mages who learn Research can be prevented from accessing it.
Warriors' Dual Wield Specialization is granting both the main-hand and off-hand 2/4/6/8/10% hit chance; it should only apply to the off-hand.
Retribution Aura uses the target's spell power instead of the Paladin's.
The Taillasher Eggs for the quest "Break A Few Eggs" do not respawn as quickly as intended (fixed in a later build).
Anduin Wrynn and other children unintentionally have hats; Blizzard is working on removing them.
